description: Violates E3 / E4 (verification-contract.md §5.3–§5.4): a declared check's evidence omits 'recorded'. Verification outcomes merge into the runtime's verification report and are recorded as lifecycle evidence — part of the persisted, queryable, authoritative lifecycle state from which decisions derive. A check whose evidence is not recorded cannot be re-checked by any consumer afterward; the required evidence declaration rejects the omission.
